about: Every 5-star Google review with text, rendered into site/index.html by tools/build_reviews.py. Edit this file, not the HTML. Read from the INVICTUS Training Center Google Maps listing, signed in, on 2026-09-22: 41 reviews, all 5 stars; 37 have text. The four without text (Cady, Dan Germain, Michael Henriquez, Rachel Jerke) are stars only and are left out. The PSD's three come first, as designed (their avatars are cut from the PSD); the rest follow Google's 'Most relevant' order. Text is verbatim.

reviews.name: Adam Richardson
reviews.text: I went in for a morning session. The instructor, David Carlson, did a great job and took his job seriously. I felt welcomed and it was a comfortable atmosphere. I think I learned some things as well.
reviews.source: Google Maps (also in the PSD screenshot, word for word)

reviews.name: Kaylee Drozewski
reviews.text: Invites training center has really help me and everyone there is like family to me and it wouldn't be here now if it wasn't for nate he has done everything he can to make sure everyone is comfortable and happy
reviews.source: Google Maps (also in the PSD screenshot, word for word)

reviews.name: Crystal Nadeau
reviews.text: The owner, Nate, truly cares about being THE BEST coach possible. Every class he teaches is like a seminar. Very welcoming. This place has THE BEST WOMEN’S PROGRAM I have seen and I have trained at various gyms. If you’re a female interested in BJJ, this gym is for you.
reviews.source: Google Maps (also in the PSD screenshot)

reviews.name: Nicole Iovanni
reviews.text: I began training at Invictus in December. My husband and daughter train at the gym and I wanted to try to women's classes. As a beginner I was intimidated to start. The owner Nate and coaches Johnny and Laura were incredibly supportive. They met me at my skill level and continue to push me forward so that I improve. The training is challenging in the best way; I am a calmer, happier, more confident person because of it. I highly recommend this gym and community. Fun for the whole family :)

reviews.name: Trock
reviews.text:
The Owner is an incredibly skilled grappler, he received his black belt from world famous Judoka and the fastest person to get a legit black belt ever in BJJ from John Danaher black belt Travis Stevens. To get a black belt under Travis is one of the most difficult things to accomplish as Travis has only given that honor to a handful of students in almost 15 years as teaching.

To get an idea of the high level instruction that coach Nate gives his students I highly recommend getting the butterfly effect from BJJ fanatics an in-depth systematic teaching of the butterfly guard that will make this guard a strong part of your game.

reviews.name: Josh Vecchio
reviews.text: I trained at Invictus for nearly a year and a half, and I have nothing but great things to say about the gym. All of the instructors are as knowledgable as they are kind, and the community of members feels like a second family. Under Nate's leadership, the culture is one that balances hard work and intention with fun and good times. If you're looking for a gym that perfectly harmonizes elite level training with a harmonious social atmosphere, Invictus is the place to be.

reviews.name: Ricky Siewers
reviews.text: I’ve tried BJJ gyms all across NYC and Boston and nothing compares to the incredible community Nate and his team have created at Invictus. Staff is highly skilled and welcoming to new comers while also providing an avenue for growth at the highest level of the sport. Couldn’t recommend more highly.

reviews.name: Ashley Mak
reviews.text:
Dropped in for a class today at 10am. The coach Johnny was so knowledgeable and welcoming. We had a great class where we focused on some really good solid basics, and then followed up with sparring.

The gym is beautiful, clean and spacious. Really great energy and a super welcoming community.

The owner Nate was there too and made me feel super welcome.

Martial arts can be a very intimidating activity, especially with something as close quarters as jiujitsu.

Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Erin Ronder Neves
reviews.text: My two girls have been going to Invictus for years. Coach Nate and the other coaches are the best of the best. They meet my girls where they are at, challenge them, and help them gain confidence every class. It’s amazing how much more self-aware and strong they are (both mentally and physically!) because of the BJJ and Muay Thai classes they do every week. So grateful for this community. HIGHLY recommend!

reviews.name: Patrick Russell
reviews.text: I dropped in to Invictus Training Center while in town visiting family. I don’t know what more you could look for in a Jiu Jitsu school. The atmosphere is super relaxed and friendly, the instruction is top notch, and Nate and his team went out of their way to make me feel welcome. For sure, I can’t recommend Invictus highly enough!

reviews.name: Kyle Misuraca
reviews.text: I’ve visited many gyms in my 11 + years of training BJJ and Invictus has one of the best atmospheres I’ve seen. Has a really strong community of students that range from hobbyists to competitors. The facility is big, very clean, and has a great design. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Parker Jamison
reviews.text: The instructors here are welcoming, attentive, and thorough in their teaching approach. Whatever your level or reason for training BJJ, there is a space for you here. The gym's owner, Nate, really sets the tone of the place, one that encourages and challenges within a great camaraderie. Drop in, check it out, introduce yourself.

reviews.name: Kieran Mackay
reviews.text: Excellent school focused on individual development as well as a welcoming community. I was new to the world of jiu jitsu when I started training at Invictus. Nate Morrison has created a special culture here & I believe every student at the school buys into his approach: no ego. Just train hard, help out your peers, & trust the process!

reviews.name: Gary Miller
reviews.text: Nate is the complete package - knowledgeable, competitive, compassionate and a great communicator/instructor. I've trained with Nate for close to eight years and still manage to pick up new techniques every time we train. In regard to his school and students, the apple doesn't fall far from the tree. They are all well mannered, dedicated and welcoming. What Nate has built is very impressive.

reviews.name: Ryan Mead
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Invictus for just under two years and have nothing but good things to say.  The jiu jitsu curriculum Nate has created is designed to link techniques with systems which makes learning so much easier.  Everyone I train with there are willing to help and work hard to get better. For sure there is a very welcoming team mentality.
There are few places like this. We are very lucky.

All you need to know is the coach is so dedicated to the lifestyle that he WILL show up to formal events in Fuji shorts and tshirt wearing a Fanny pack.

reviews.name: Aaron Chase
reviews.text: Been training under Nate for 5 years now, first at Collective BJJ and now at Invictus TC. The new facility is a fantastic upgrade! Huge uninterrupted mat space with the same great culture and curriculum based learning. Over the years BJJ has brought so much value and purpose to my life. Can’t recommend this gym highly enough!

reviews.name: Laura Adrien
reviews.text: I'm not superstitious, but I am a little stitious about why this gym is so fantastic in terms of education, equipment, and community. All of the coaches are incredible teachers who build a curriculum and are excited to help you progress; the equipment, sauna, and even bathroom are always clean; the TV is always playing BJJ instructionals or matches; but most of all the people there are what makes Invictus a great community to learn and grow. I'll keep knocking on wood and throwing salt over my shoulder, because this gym is a gem!

reviews.name: Mark Pierce
reviews.text: I just started training a couple weeks ago and I am absolutely loving it. If you have any interest in learning Brazilian jiu jitsu, Muay Thai, kickboxing to name a few, this is a great place to do it. The trainers are amazing and work with you no matter what level your at. Everyone that trains here is nice and all about helping each other get better. Daily, I ask the instructors over and over again to walk me through what they showed so I know I am doing it right. They enjoy doing it and clearly have a passion for the various forms of fighting they teach. I cannot say enough good things about Invictus, I only wish I had started sooner than now.

reviews.name: Emily Scott
reviews.text: The owner Nate is incredible with all his students and his approach to teaching.  The environment is top notch, clean, professional and everyone I met there was truly awesome.  I can't recommend this studio enough.  You will learn so many valuable skills and practices, you will not regret your decision :)

reviews.name: Devin Grant
reviews.text: I was new to jiu jitsu when I came to Invictus and it has changed my life forever. The environment is welcoming and friendly but does not sacrifice for learning serious techniques. The teachers are patient and work to develop you into a BJJ athlete.

reviews.name: Nathaniel Stone
reviews.text: Absolutely love going here, big clean training area and knowledgeable professional coaches always willing to help you with all your goals. INVICTUS really has it all. Regardless of your level of experience, you will find your martial arts needs met here.

reviews.name: Dun Ved
reviews.text: Excellent gym, top-tier instruction, amazing and welcoming community with clean facilities. If you are a complete beginner to martial arts I believe that this is the best gym to start your journey at!

reviews.name: Melissa Nieuwoudt
reviews.text: I stopped by for two classes while traveling and I’m so glad I was recommended this gym. Everyone was really welcoming and I felt like I’ve been part of the group for months. Learned so much in just one class and will definitely remember the technique. Thanks to Nate and his team!

reviews.name: Aaron Chase
reviews.text: I've been going here religiously for about a year and a half. If you're thinking about learning Jiu Jitsu, Muay Thai, or just looking to learn some self defense, this place is amazing. Nate the owner and head Jiu Jitsu instructor has created a very welcoming and friendly atmosphere with an amazing curriculum that makes it easy and fun to learn.

reviews.name: Andrew Jacobs
reviews.text:
More than just a gym, a community of friendly faces who want to see you crush your goals, Invictus jiujitsu & training center has a place for everyone. Great for all ages and levels.

Invictus is also a Super clean premises with unlimited parking.

reviews.name: Brendan Norris
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about this school. Nate is an excellent instructor who really invests himself in his students' progression. Very friendly place for beginners. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Nick Waiswilos
reviews.text:
Fantastic instruction.
Very friendly group.
Effective Striking and grappling training. Has strength and conditioning classes as wel
Lots of ancillary group activites like a monthly cookout and "book" club.
Highly recommend it to everyone I meet.

reviews.name: Bill Waiswilos
reviews.text: Amazing instructors and curriculum in a very welcoming yet competitive environment. I’ve been to a few other gyms around the area and Invictus is by far the best!

reviews.name: Jeff Ippolito
reviews.text: This is one of the best bjj schools I've been at in 10 years of doing bjj.  The curriculum is thorough, and up to date with the latest bjj techniques and series.

reviews.name: randy gerrish
reviews.text: Over 15 years of training more than a dozen schools in those years. Best training partners and coaching you could ask for . Even more importantly it’s the most inviting and clean gym around .

reviews.name: Agi DeFarlo
reviews.text: Great gym — big, clean, nice facility. The coaches are super knowledgeable and friendly. Many different classes.

reviews.name: Sri Harsha
reviews.text: Very welcoming atmosphere,  excellent rolls, and beginner friendly!

reviews.name: A FREE CACTUS
reviews.text: Great people, some of the best friends I will ever have, my second family, my second home.

reviews.name: Ryan Olivier-Meehan
reviews.text: Fantastic gym, great coaches. Highly recommend

reviews.name: E Mulligan
reviews.text: Fantastic place overall.

reviews.name: J. Stuart Moore
reviews.text: Great instructors!!!

reviews.name: Sammy Korc
reviews.text: Great place
